regression_cohorts.definition: Known delayed orders caught by frozen101 but missed by frozen104. Cohorts are defined without count102 scores; each model is ranked on the original full day.
regression_cohorts.interpretation: These are retrospective diagnostic cohorts. Recovery of an old loss is insufficient unless new losses and all other routes are also counted. Marginals overlap and are never added together.
